title: Mount Bromo Wildfire Spreads in Indonesia

blocks.content: A wildfire broke out on 3 August 2026 inside Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, Indonesia, and affected the Gunung Bromo Watu Gede and Jantur areas. The fire later spread near the volcano’s caldera, and emergency agencies deployed helicopters, fire trucks, and drones for containment.

items: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in East Java and forms part of the Tengger volcanic complex.
Water-bombing is an aerial firefighting method that uses helicopters or aircraft to drop water on active fire zones.
A caldera is a large volcanic depression formed after an eruption or collapse of a volcano’s summit area.
Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park is a major protected area in Indonesia and a frequent site of volcanic and tourism-related news.
